panel.title: 🎫 Help Center
panel.description: Got a question, a problem or something to report? Pick the right category below – we'll open a **private channel** that only you and our team can see.
rules: Describe your issue in as much detail as possible – it speeds things up
Don't ping the staff – they are notified automatically
Tickets without a reply are closed automatically

questions.label: Subject
questions.placeholder: E.g. my role is not working

questions.label: Describe the issue in detail
questions.placeholder: What happened, when, and what have you already tried?

ticketTypes.label: Punishment Appeal
ticketTypes.description: Appeal a ban, mute or warning

questions.label: What punishment did you get and when?

snippets.name: 👋 Greeting
snippets.content: Hi {user}! My name is {staff} and I'll be handling your ticket. Give me a moment to look into it.

snippets.name: 🔍 Ask for details
snippets.content: {user}, we need a bit more information. Please describe exactly what happened and attach screenshots if you can.

snippets.name: ⏳ Please wait
snippets.content: I've passed this on, {user}. We'll get back to you as soon as possible – thanks for your patience!

snippets.name: ✅ Resolved
snippets.content: Looks like the issue has been resolved 🎉 If you need anything else, just write here – otherwise we'll close the ticket.

snippets.name: 📜 Rules
snippets.content: {user}, please make sure you've read the rules of **{server}**. Thank you!
